descriptions.default: Two mourners with arms raised: the lament at the head of the procession.
Six women walk with their hands to their chests.
An empty canopy frame carried in the procession.
A man hauls the canopy frame on its sledge by a rope.

anubis_on_a_chest.name: Anubis on a chest

descriptions.default: Anubis as a jackal on a chest, dragged on a sledge. You will meet him again at the judgment.

anubis_on_a_chest.reference: Tawfik 2022 (the chest of the canopic jars)

descriptions.default: A man hauls Anubis's chest on its sledge by a rope.
A processional boat with the funerary bier.
A priest walks before the bier with a censer, offering incense.
A man hauls the sledge rope.
A man with a stick drives the ox that pulls the sledge.
The ox pulls the sledge with the mummy's bier.
The sacred apis bull, crowned with plumes, walking along the procession.
descriptions.unresolved: A bull walking towards the sacrifice.

descriptions.default: A young calf leaps toward the plumed ox.
descriptions.unsettled: The young calf shakes at the sight of the sacrifice.

descriptions.default: A man walks under a portable canopy.
A man carries two vessels on a shoulder yoke.
Two women walk in the procession.
A bull is thrown down and butchered.
descriptions.unresolved: The Apis bull should never be slaughtered. (Not even Cambyses did it, despite what Herodotus claimed.)

descriptions.default: The lector priest reads from a scroll.
Another large pile of offerings, with more architectural integrity.
A great heaped table of bread, meat, fowl and fruit, between palm leaves.
descriptions.collapsed: The offering table has collapsed. Only a few loaves, a small head and a pomegranate still stand; everything else lies on the floor between the bouquets. Speak with the lector priest beside it.

descriptions.default: A man holds a water jar over the offering table for purification.
Two obelisks stand on their bases.

offering_stand.name: Low table

descriptions.default: A small stand with two rods, a hooked adze, and a foreleg laid on it.

offering_stand.reference: Tawfik 2022 (the instruments for the Opening of the Mouth)

priest_with_arm_censer.name: Priest with arm-censer

descriptions.default: He holds incense over the small stand, purifying the sacred implements for the Opening of the Mouth ritual.

priest_with_arm_censer.reference: Tawfik 2022; Tawfik reads the object as the wer-hekaw (a ram-headed tool for the Opening of the Mouth), not a censer

descriptions.default: A lector priest in a two-feather headdress reads something from a sheet.
A standard carried on a pole, topped with a jackal.
A standard carried on a pole, topped with an ibis.
A standard carried on a pole, topped with a falcon.
A standard carried on a pole, topped with a bull.
A standard carried on a pole, topped with a vulture.
A standard carried on a pole, topped with the placenta emblem.
A standard carried on a pole, topped with two plumes.
A standard carried on a pole, topped with a falcon, like the third.
A priest raises a round jar and pours purifying water. The wavy line is the stream: it arches over Anubis and the mummy.
A woman kneels with her hands raised, under the stream of water.

anubis_and_the_mummy.name: Anubis and the mummy

descriptions.default: Anubis holds the mummy upright on a low base before the tomb.
descriptions.unopened: Anubis holds the mummy upright on a low base before the tomb. The mummy's mouth is not opened yet, and needs the right tool.

anubis_and_the_mummy.reference: Tawfik 2022 (a priest in a jackal mask, as Anubis)

descriptions.default: A round-topped stela under the winged sun. Faint on its face: a stand, the sun disc on it, a lotus bending over it.
descriptions.blank: A round-topped stela under the winged sun. Its face is blank.

descriptions.default: The tomb: a chapel with a cornice, crowned by a small pyramid.

ra_enthroned.name: Ra enthroned

descriptions.default: Ra sits on his throne with the sun disc on his head and a staff in his hand.

ra_enthroned.reference: Tawfik 2022 (Re-Horakhty, the last scene of spell 1)

descriptions.default: Beginning of the chapters about the going forth by day and the carrying of the shades into the Netherworld.
To be said on the day of burial in order to go in after coming forth.

caption_3.name: Spell 1

descriptions.default: Adoration to Ra when he rises above the eastern horizon in Heaven.

caption_3.reference: Davis 1894; Tawfik 2022 (the Ra scene ends spell 1; Davis and Mosher 2022 put it with spell 15)

caption_4.name: Spell 1

descriptions.default: Adoration to the sun when it sets in the Land of Life.

caption_4.reference: Davis 1894; Tawfik 2022 (the Ra scene ends spell 1; Davis and Mosher 2022 put it with spell 15)

mouth_words.name: Spell 1

descriptions.default: Adoration to Tmu setting down in the Land of Life.

mouth_words.reference: Davis 1894 (the third title of spell 15); Tawfik 2022 (the Ra scene ends spell 1)
